verdict.rationale: The Comptroller's own pages say returns can be filed and paid online through Webfile, reached via the eSystems portal (docs-1, docs-2). Payment by Web EFT or credit card through Webfile is documented for franchise tax (docs-7). Probe-4 confirms the Webfile transaction surface exists behind an authenticated eSystems session. Missing for 10: some forms must still be downloaded and mailed (docs-6), electronic franchise report submission is documented only through approved third-party software rather than first-party, and no hands-on corroboration of a completed end-to-end filing.
